sections.html: The Siamese Dwarf Rasbora (Trigonostigma somphongsi, formerly Rasbora somphongsi) was scientifically described in 1958 from specimens imported by the ornamental fish trade at the end of 1957 from Thailand. Origin: Thailand. Available size: 2-2.5 cm.

The exact type locality was unknown from the beginning. The original description mentioned only "Thailand"; later Meinken wrote that they originate from "southern Menam (Thailand)".

In the past 20 years the species was thought to be extinct in the wild. In the international Red List entry (C. Vidthayanon, 2013) the area of distribution is given as the basin of the Mae Khlong near Ratchaburi in central Thailand. The species could no longer be found there due to habitat destruction. It was listed as "critically endangered" rather than "extinct in the wild" because single specimens were occasionally spotted among mixed catches of other ornamental fish, though it was not known where they had been collected. The habitat of the fish in the wild has now been rediscovered.
Keeping the fish in the aquarium is completely undemanding. They only grow to 2-2.5 cm long.
T. somphongsi prefers to live in schools, but for spawning the pairs most often separate from the others. The males even defend a small spawning territory for a short time.

Like all close relatives (e.g. the harlequin barbs Trigonostigma heteromorpha, T. espei and T. hengeli) they spawn on the underside of broad plant leaves. So-called V-tanks are ideally suited for extensive breeding of this species; young fish can usually be separated on a regular basis.

Lexicon: Trigonostigma means "triangle spot". somphongsi is a dedication name for the discoverer and ornamental fish exporter Somphongs. Rasbora comes from the vernacular name of one of the species in Bengal.

Meinken, H. (1958): Rasbora somphongsi, eine neue Zwergrasbora. XXIX. Mitteilungen der Fischbestimmungsstelle des VDA. Die Aquarien- und Terrarienzeitschrift 11 (3): 67-69

Meinken, H. (1958): Rasbora somphongsi nov. spec., eine neue Rasbora aus Siam (Pisces: Cyprinidae, Unterfam. Rasborinae). Opulusca Zoologica Nr. 19 (Oktober 1958): 1-6

Vidthayanon, C. (2013): Trigonostigma somphongsi. The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species. Version 2014.3.
